meta.name: ui-ux-pro-max
meta.description: UI/UX design intelligence for web and mobile. Searchable local database with 84 styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, 192 product types, 98 UX guidelines, 104 icon entries, 16 GSAP motion presets, and 25 chart types across 22 stacks (React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, Astro, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Jetpack Compose, Angular, Laravel, JavaFX, WPF, WinUI, Avalonia, Uno Platform, UWP, Three.js, and HTML/CSS). Use when designing, building, or reviewing UI: pages, components, color schemes, typography, layout, accessibility, animation, or data visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 随时查阅界面风格、配色、字体与动效规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计网页或应用界面，想快速找到合适的风格与规范。
copy.tagline_en: Look up UI styles, palettes, fonts, and motion presets on demand.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build websites or apps and need quick design guidance.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 在设计或评审界面时,会先从本地数据库检索 UI/UX 规则,再产出按优先级排序的建议,覆盖配色、字体、布局、动效、图表等,并可生成可保存的设计系统文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求设计新页面、搭建或重构界面组件、选择配色字体布局、评审界面可用性或实现导航、表单、动效时触发。

say.text: 帮我用设计系统给一个 SaaS 后台首页出方案
按“娱乐、暗色、动感”找 3 个配色方案
say.note: 触发 color 域的数据库搜索,返回色板。

say.text: 检查这个移动端页面的无障碍和对比度
say.note: 触发 ux 域检查,列出可达性等问题。

howto.what_en: After installing, when designing or reviewing UI, Claude searches a local database of UI/UX rules and produces priority-ranked recommendations covering color, typography, layout, motion, charts, and can generate a saved design-system file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to design new pages, build or refactor UI components, choose color/typography/layout, review usability, or implement navigation, forms, or animation.

say_en.text: Generate a design system for a SaaS admin homepage.
Find 3 color palettes for an entertainment, dark, dynamic theme.
say_en.note: Triggers a color-domain search and returns palettes.

say_en.text: Check this mobile page for accessibility and contrast.
say_en.note: Runs the UX-domain check and lists issues.
